content: LINE webhook best practice: must return 2xx within ~2 seconds or LINE sends a request_timeout notice to the channel admin; recommended pattern is to acknowledge immediately and desynchronize (queue) all real processing. A single webhook payload may contain multiple event objects for different users. Duplicate delivery is expected (network retries) -- dedupe using webhookEventId. Signature must be verified before processing. This matches SPEC.md §7's requirement to only write to job_queue and return, and its idempotency_keys use of webhookEventId.
